text:
maria: Noticed a small set of UX/a11y nits in the Batch -> Preview -> Export flow after the last prototype test. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/vecs-export (screenshot)
maria: Key things: column labels in the preview are inconsistent with the export header (e.g., preview shows 'title' but CSV header uses 'metadata.title'). Testers were surprised when their scripts failed.
jamie: Awkward. Suggest we surface the exact CSV header in the export modal as a selectable line (read-only input) so users can copy/paste it. Label it clearly: 'CSV header (copy to use in scripts)'.
lina: For screen readers, the header preview should be exposed as a live region when it updates and the copy button needs aria-label 'Copy CSV header to clipboard'. Also ensure the preview input is readOnly and focusable.
aqil: Copy tweak: change preview label from 'Columns included' to 'CSV header preview' and modal CTA to 'Download CSV (selected fields)'. Avoid 'export' verb ambiguity.
sam: UX detail: if users rename metadata fields via mapping, reflect that rename in the header sample immediately and show a tiny 'mapped' badge. Also add a small note: 'Header order matches CSV columns'.
designbot: Reminder: any change to header string requires telemetry event header_preview_copied. Check telemetry docs: https://redwood.infra/docs/telemetry/export-events
maria: Actionable: Lina adds a11y notes + aria-live example in Figma, Jamie implements selectable header input + copy button, Aqil updates copy and modal labels, Sam wires mapping badge. I'll schedule a quick 10m sync tomorrow 11:15 to approve. :thumbsup:
